title: ops-cafe-standup-console-2027-06-21
content:
Context:
Quick midweek ops-cafe — informal standup to surface small rollouts, telemetry oddities, and pairing requests. Aim: capture action items before people vanish into focus work. Mostly console UI + rollout orchestration + analytics handoff.

Attendees (quick):
- Aisha (lead) — console UX + rollout planner
- Markus — telemetry & ingestion
- Renee — frontend, panel gating
- Tom — rollout automation, feature flags
- (drop-ins: SRE on-call via Slack thread)

Highlights / What’s new since yesterday:
- Small UX patch rolled to canary region A: panel transition jitter reduced ~70% for 1280x720 clients. Observed via session-replay sampling. (PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/2145).
- Telemetry spike at 11:03 caused delayed metric aggregation for rollouts UI for ~12 minutes; root cause looks like a transient shard overload in the analytics pipeline (ingest-batch backpressure). Markus investigating.
- A/B gating: canary allowing 10% traffic but we noticed skewed error rate toward heavy clients using older Chromium. Renee to add UA filter to canary.

Open issues / friction points:
- Session replay sampling is currently additive and inflates event counts on canary because of duplicate send from fallback client. Need small dedupe layer or unique session id stamping. (Ticket: CR-732).
- Rollout dashboard latency: slow queries when joining rollout_events with user_segments for > 1m users. We should pre-aggregate recent 24h window. Query example included in linked_artifacts.
- Observability gaps: token-level cost heatmap not surfaced when rolling back model routing on dedicated endpoints — product asked for a short-term manual export.

Decisions made in this session:
- Pause expansion of the canary to region B until UA filter added and telemetry ingestion fix deployed to staging. (Owner: Renee / Markus).
- Ship the small dedupe helper in the ingestion shim as a hotfix behind a feature flag; validate on staging with synthetic sessions. (Owner: Markus, ETA 2027-06-23).

Action items (owners + rough ETA):
1) Markus: create ingestion shim PR (dedupe-by-session) and run perf bench, post results in #telemetry-ops. ETA: 2027-06-23.
2) Renee: add UA-based filter rule to canary gating and update rollout policy description in the console. ETA: 2027-06-22.
3) Tom: add a short-term pre-aggregation job for rollout_events 24h window (lambda job) and attach to dashboard; scope as temporary until query index changes landed. ETA: 2027-06-24.
4) Aisha: prepare a one-pager for product outlining manual token-cost export steps and a proposed roadmap to fully integrate cost heatmap into rollback UI. ETA: 2027-06-25.
5) All: quick smoke on staging after Markus' shim lands — 30m paired session to validate dedupe and replay sampling. Schedule in shared calendar. (Owners: everyone), when shim merged.

Notes to self / low priority ideas:
- Consider moving session-replay sampling into a dedicated sampling proxy so we can change behavior per-release without touching client code.
- Possible short-term UX: show a subtle warning in rollout UI when telemetry ingestion lag > 5m. Helps PMs avoid expanding canaries blindly.

Unresolved questions:
- How do we want to represent deduped events vs dropped events in the analytics UI? Add a small legend? Product input needed.
- Can we safely compress older rollout_events to a coarser bucket after 48h without losing rollback signal? Data team to weigh in.

Quick sync followups scheduled:
- Telemetry deep-dive (Markus) Friday 2027-06-25 10:00 — include SRE and data infra.
- Rollout gating review (Renee + Aisha) Thursday 2027-06-24 14:00 — review UA filter test results and canary ramp plan.

Random captures / adhoc snippets recorded in meeting:
- Renee: "We should treat older Chromium as a separate cohort for UI gating until we drop support; they behave like mobile web with weird repaint paths."
- Tom: "If pre-aggregation reduces dashboard latency, add a flag to auto-turn off when enrollment < 200k users to avoid wasted compute."

Tags / search hints for later: ops-cafe, rollout-gating, telemetry-shim, dedupe, session-replay, canary-hold

End of notes.
(Informal capture — more formal writeup to follow if any of the action items change status.)
